title: Service of process
summary: Service of process is the formal delivery or legally authorized communication of the summons and complaint or equivalent initiating papers. It tells a defendant that a judicial proceeding requires a response.
notes: The full text of Rule 4 is in the 2026–2027 Rules supplement on file (PDF page 13), linked below; the casebook discussion does not reproduce every clause, exception, deadline or current amendment.

sections.Meaning: Service of process is the formal delivery or legally authorized communication of the summons and complaint or equivalent initiating papers. It tells a defendant that a judicial proceeding requires a response.
sections.How to work through the question: Identify the court system, type of defendant, location of service, person who served, method used, and applicable rule. Then separately evaluate constitutional notice and whether service establishes the needed territorial reach.
